description: Taiwan business tax: small-scale businesses under the monthly threshold are exempt (from 2025-01-01: 100,000 TWD for trading, manufacturing and ordinary food service; 50,000 TWD for renovation, advertising, repair, lodging, leasing, technical and design services; mixed businesses taxed when the ratios add up to 100%); small-scale businesses at or above it are assessed at 1% (Business Tax Act art. 13, 23); invoice-issuing businesses pay 5% output minus input tax (art. 10). The sales level for switching to uniform invoices is not verified. Taiwan, as of 2026-11-21 (law.moj.gov.tw and Ministry of Finance). General information and estimates only; no individual tax advice, agency or filing. The 2025 tax year is 114年度, filed in May 2026; national-holiday deadline shifts are not computed, only weekends.

goodsSales.description: Monthly (or, with invoices, this period's) sales in the 100,000 TWD threshold group (TWD)

purchases.description: Purchases and expenses excluding tax this period (TWD)

serviceSales.description: Sales in the 50,000 TWD threshold group (TWD)
